text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- The Swiss transport ministry will review a new EU proposal, which will include a new quota for the number of 40 ton trucks to cross the Alps.
- The Swiss lower house of parliament will debate a new telecommunication law this week, which will include liberalisation of some parts of the Swiss Telecom.

- Rolf Hueppi, president of the Swiss insurance group Zuerich said in an interview that the group did not plan to axe thousands of jobs like the banks did and that Switzerland is still attractive as a business location.
- Analysts at Merrill Lynch predicted record profits for Swiss chemical group Roche in 1997.

- A young polictical group called 'Born on December 6, 1992' will not withdraw its initiative seeking to bring Switzerland into the European Economic Area. Many pro European representatives criticise the group and its initiative.
